value.rationale: A natural exact silhouette complexity probability is completely evaluated and globally optimized for every odd-sided regular bipyramid. The nontrivial parity-dependent angular lattice yields an asymptotic factor of two compared with even-sided dual sections, a structural rather than a numerical novelty.
